title: File:Crans-Montana vu du ciel.jpg
claims: The image is an aerial daylight view of Crans-Montana: a plateau resort town with golf courses, dense low-rise buildings, conifer slopes and surrounding mountain ridges.

Commons titles the photograph Crans-Montana vu du ciel, a view from the air; it shows the resort environment, not the Wild 110 start arch, finish line, aid station, timing mat, course marking or race-day crowd.
The author is Raph75014; the file is licensed CC BY 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2023-08-03 at 10:54:34; the original is 4,032 x 2,268 pixels and 4,111,496 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 540 copy of 200,483 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Raph75014, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
